description: This file defines a Jekyll plugin module that provides a custom filter to generate Gravatar image URLs from email addresses.

classes.name: Jekyll::GravatarFilter
classes.description: A module defining a custom Liquid filter for generating Gravatar URLs based on email input.

methods.name: to_gravatar
methods.description: Generates a Gravatar URL for a given email input, with an optional size parameter.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Creates an MD5 hash of the email address, used for Gravatar URL generation.
